evidence.reason: The emitter still uses text-mode stdout and Path.write_text/read_text with default newline handling. On Windows, print can emit CRLF and write_text writes CRLF, while read_text normalizes CRLF back to LF, so the stdout bytes and checked-in fixture are not exact UTF-8 vector bytes and --check can miss a CRLF fixture. The proposed binary write/read and byte comparison address the defect.
